critic_risk_flags: Although H aligns semantically with hospitalization rate, adding an explicit H compartment is specifically noted as weakly identifiable in short single-season series. With only 31 training points and high peakiness, SEIHR(H) risks parameter non-identifiability and unstable forecasts relative to delayed_I templates.

I+H is not a recommended primary map for a hospitalization-rate target (recommended: delayed_I, H, I+H but with caution). In SEIHR, mixing I and H can further worsen identifiability by allowing compensating changes between I and H to match the same observed series, especially with short data; also risks misalignment if the target is admissions rather than a mixture.
